SELECT
      l_returnflag,
      l_linestatus,
      SUM(l_quantity) AS sum_qty,
      SUM(l_extendedprice) AS sum_base_price,
      SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS sum_disc_price,
      SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) * (1 + l_tax)) AS sum_charge,
      AVG(l_quantity) AS avg_qty,
      AVG(l_extendedprice) AS avg_price,
      AVG(l_discount) AS avg_disc,
      COUNT(*) AS count_order
    FROM
      lineitem
    WHERE
      l_receiptdate <= '1998-09-02'
    GROUP BY
      l_returnflag,
      l_linestatus
    ORDER BY
      l_returnflag,
      l_linestatus

SELECT 
    n1.n_name AS supp_nation,
    n2.n_name AS cust_nation,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) AS l_year,
    SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue
FROM lineitem l
JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
JOIN nation n1 ON s.s_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey
JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
JOIN nation n2 ON c.c_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey
JOIN nation n3 ON n1.n_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey
JOIN nation n4 ON n2.n_nationkey = n3.n_nationkey
JOIN nation n5 ON n3.n_nationkey = n4.n_nationkey
JOIN nation n6 ON n4.n_nationkey = n5.n_nationkey
JOIN nation n7 ON n5.n_nationkey = n6.n_nationkey
JOIN nation n8 ON n6.n_nationkey = n7.n_nationkey
JOIN nation n9 ON n7.n_nationkey = n8.n_nationkey
WHERE n1.n_name IN ('FRANCE', 'GERMANY')
AND n2.n_name IN ('FRANCE', 'GERMANY')
AND n3.n_name IN ('FRANCE', 'GERMANY')
AND n4.n_name IN ('FRANCE', 'GERMANY')
AND n5.n_name IN ('FRANCE', 'GERMANY')

SELECT 
    l.l_shipmode,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN o.o_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') THEN 1 END) AS high_line_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN o.o_orderpriority NOT IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') THEN 1 END) AS low_line_count
FROM lineitem l
JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
WHERE l.l_shipmode IN ('MAIL', 'SHIP')
    AND l.l_shipdate >= '1994-01-01'
    AND l.l_shipdate < '1995-01-01'
    AND l.l_receiptdate > l.l_commitdate
    AND l.l_shipdate < l.l_commitdate
GROUP BY l.l_shipmode
ORDER BY l.l_shipmode

SELECT
            p_brand,
            p_type,
            p_size,
            COUNT(DISTINCT s_suppkey) AS supplier_cnt
        FROM
            part
        JOIN
            partsupp ON part.p_partkey = partsupp.ps_partkey
        JOIN
            supplier ON partsupp.ps_suppkey = supplier.s_suppkey
        WHERE
            p_brand != 'Brand#45'
            AND p_type NOT LIKE 'MEDIUM POLISHED%'
            AND p_size IN (49, 14, 23, 45, 19, 3, 36, 9)
            AND s_comment NOT LIKE '%Customer%Complaints%'
            AND s_acctbal >= 0
        GROUP BY

SELECT
            n.n_name AS supp_nation,
            n.n_name AS cust_nation,
            YEAR(o.o_orderdate) AS l_year,
            SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue
        FROM
            lineitem l
            JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
            JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
            JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
            JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
            JOIN nation n2 ON s.s_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey
        WHERE
            n2.n_name = 'FRANCE'
            AND n2.n_name = 'GERMANY'
            AND l.l_shipdate >= '1995-01-01'
            AND l.l_shipdate <= '1996-12-31'
            AND o.o_orderdate >= '1995-01-01'
            AND o.o_orderdate <= '1996-12-31'
        GROUP BY
            n.n_name,
            n.n_name,
            YEAR(o.o_orderdate)
        ORDER BY
            n.n_name,
            n.n_name,
            YEAR(o.o_orderdate)

SELECT
      l.l_shipmode,
      SUM(CASE WHEN o.o_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_line_count,
      SUM(CASE WHEN o.o_orderpriority NOT IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_line_count
    FROM
      lineitem l
    JOIN
      orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
    WHERE
      l.l_shipmode IN ('MAIL', 'SHIP')
      AND l.l_shipdate >= '1994-01-01'
      AND l.l_shipdate < '1995-01-01'
      AND l.l_receiptdate > l.l_commitdate
    GROUP BY
      l.l_shipmode
    ORDER BY
      l.l_shipmode

    SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue
FROM
    region r
JOIN
    nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey

    supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey

    lineitem l ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey

    orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey

    r.r_name = 'ASIA'

GROUP BY
    n.n_name

SELECT
  c.c_custkey,
  c.c_name,
  SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue,
  c.c_acctbal,
  n.n_name,
  c.c_address,
  c.c_phone,
  c.c_comment
FROM lineitem l
JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
WHERE
  l.l_shipdate >= '1993-10-01'
  AND l.l_shipdate < '1994-01-01'
  AND l.l_returnflag = 'R'
GROUP BY
  c.c_custkey,
  c.c_name,
  c.c_acctbal,
  n.n_name,
  c.c_address,
  c.c_phone,
  c.c_comment
ORDER BY
  revenue DESC
LIMIT 20

SELECT s.s_name, s.s_address
        FROM supplier s
        JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
        JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
        JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
        JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_suppkey = l.l_suppkey AND ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey
        WHERE n.n_name = 'CANADA'
        AND p.p_name LIKE '%forest%'
        AND ps.ps_availqty > 0.5 * (SELECT SUM(l_quantity) FROM lineitem WHERE l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND l_shipdate >= '1994-01-01' AND l_shipdate < '1995-01-01')

1.  **Analyze the Request:**
    *   **Goal:** Find suppliers in 'CANADA' who have at least one part with a name containing 'forest' where the available quantity (`ps_availqty`) is greater than half the total quantity (`l_quantity`) of that part shipped by that supplier in 1994.

SELECT
    p.p_brand,
    p.p_type,
    p.p_size,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_cnt
FROM
    part p
JOIN
    partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey
JOIN
    supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
WHERE
    p.p_brand != 'Brand#45'
    AND p.p_type NOT LIKE 'MEDIUM POLISHED%'
    AND p.p_size IN (49, 14, 23, 45, 19, 3, 36, 9)
    AND s.s_comment NOT LIKE '%Customer%Complaints%'
    AND s.s_acctbal > 0
GROUP BY
    p.p_brand,
    p.p_type,
    p.p_size
ORDER BY
    supplier_cnt DESC,
    p.p_brand ASC,
    p.p_type ASC,
    p.p_size ASC

SELECT 
    SUM(l_extendedprice) / 7.0 AS avg_yearly
FROM lineitem l
JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
WHERE p.p_brand = 'Brand#23'
    AND l.l_quantity < (
        SELECT AVG(l2.l_quantity)
        FROM lineitem l2
        WHERE l2.l_partkey = l.l_partkey
    )
    AND l.l_quantity < 0.2 * (
        SELECT AVG(l3.l_quantity)
        FROM lineitem l3
        WHERE l3.l_partkey = l.l_partkey
    )

The user wants to calculate "Small-quantity-order revenue" for parts of brand 'Brand#23'.

Let me break down the requirements:
1. Filter parts where p_brand = 'Brand#23'
2. For each part, calculate the average quantity of all line items for that part
3. Filter line items where quantity < 20% of the average quantity for that part
4. Calculate the sum of extended price of those line items
5. Divide by 7.0 (average yearly revenue)
6. Output column: avg_yearly

SELECT 
    c.c_custkey,
    c.c_name,
    SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue,
    c.c_acctbal,
    n.n_name,
    c.c_address,
    c.c_phone,
    c.c_comment
FROM lineitem l
JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1993-10-01' 
    AND l.l_shipdate < '1994-01-01'
    AND l.l_returnflag = 'R'
GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, n.n_name, c.c_address, c.c_phone, c.c_comment
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 20

GROUP BY

SELECT
            l.l_shipmode,
            COUNT(CASE WHEN o.o_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') THEN 1 END) AS high_line_count,
            COUNT(CASE WHEN o.o_orderpriority NOT IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') THEN 1 END) AS low_line_count
        FROM lineitem l
        JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
        WHERE
            l.l_shipmode IN ('MAIL', 'SHIP')
            AND l.l_shipdate >= '1994-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1995-01-01'
            AND l.l_receiptdate > l.l_commitdate
        GROUP BY
            l.l_shipmode
        ORDER BY
            l.l_shipmode

      l.l_shipmode,
      COUNT(CASE WHEN o.o_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') THEN 1 END) AS high_line_count,
      COUNT(CASE WHEN o.o_orderpriority NOT IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') THEN 1 END) AS low_line_count

      lineitem l

      AND l.l_shipdate < '1995-01-01'

      l.l_shipmode

WITH supplier_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_suppkey,
        s.s_name,
        s.s_address,
        s.s_phone,
        SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue
    FROM lineitem l
    JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
    WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1996-04-01'
    GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_address, s.s_phone
)
SELECT
    s_suppkey,
    s_name,
    s_address,
    s_phone,
    total_revenue
FROM supplier_revenue
WHERE total_revenue = (SELECT MIN(total_revenue) FROM supplier_revenue)
ORDER BY s_suppkey

results.sql:
SELECT
      n.n_name,
      SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue
    FROM
      region r
      JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey
      JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
      JOIN lineitem l ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
      JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
    WHERE
      r.r_name = 'ASIA'
      AND o.o_orderdate >= '1994-01-01'
      AND o.o_orderdate < '1995-01-01'
    GROUP BY
      n.n_name
    ORDER BY
      revenue DESC

SELECT 
  s.s_name,
  s.s_address
FROM supplier s
JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_suppkey = l.l_suppkey AND ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey
WHERE n.n_name = 'CANADA'
  AND p.p_name LIKE '%forest%'
  AND ps.ps_availqty > (
    SELECT SUM(l2.l_quantity)
    FROM lineitem l2
    WHERE l2.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
      AND l2.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey
      AND l2.l_shipdate >= '1994-01-01'
      AND l2.l_shipdate < '1995-01-01'
  )
ORDER BY s.s_name

    n.n_name AS n_name,
    n.n_nationkey,
    c.c_custkey,
    c.c_acctbal,
    c.c_phone
  FROM customer c
  JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
  WHERE n.n_name IN ('13', '31', '23', '29', '30', '18', '17')
    AND c.c_phone LIKE '1%'
),
customer_filter AS (
  SELECT 
    n.n_nationkey,
    c.c_custkey,
    c.c_acctbal,
    c.c_phone
  FROM customer c
  JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
  WHERE n.n_name IN ('13', '31', '23', '29', '30', '18', '17')
    AND c.c_phone LIKE '1%'
    AND c.c_acctbal > (
      SELECT AVG(c2.c_acctbal) 
      FROM customer c2 
      JOIN nation n2 ON c2.c_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey 
      WHERE n2.n_name IN ('13', '31', '23', '29', '30', '18', '17')
        AND c2.c_phone LIKE '1%'
    )
  AND c.c_custkey IN (
    SELECT o.o_custkey

results.sql:
SELECT
    p.p_brand,
    p.p_type,
    p.p_size,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_cnt
FROM
    part p
JOIN
    partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey
JOIN
    supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
WHERE
    p.p_brand != 'Brand#45'
    AND p.p_type NOT LIKE 'MEDIUM POLISHED%'
    AND p.p_size IN (49, 14, 23, 45, 19, 3, 36, 9)
    AND s.s_comment NOT LIKE '%Customer%Complaints%'
    AND s.s_acctbal > 0
GROUP BY
    p.p_brand,
    p.p_type,
    p.p_size
ORDER BY
    supplier_cnt DESC,
    p.p_brand ASC,
    p.p_type ASC,
    p.p_size ASC

SELECT
            EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) AS o_year,
            SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS mkt_share
        FROM orders
        JOIN lineitem ON orders.o_orderkey = lineitem.l_orderkey
        JOIN customer ON orders.o_custkey = customer.c_custkey
        JOIN nation ON customer.c_nationkey = nation.n_nationkey
        JOIN region ON nation.n_regionkey = region.r_regionkey
        JOIN part ON lineitem.l_partkey = part.p_partkey
        WHERE o_orderdate >= '1995-01-01' AND o_orderdate <= '1996-12-31'
          AND region.r_name = 'AMERICA'
          AND part.p_type = 'ECONOMY ANODIZED STEEL'
          AND nation.n_name = 'BRAZIL'
        GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate)
        ORDER BY o_year

    l.l_shipmode,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN o.o_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_line_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN o.o_orderpriority NOT IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_line_count

    l.l_shipdate >= '1995-09-01'

WITH supplier_revenue AS (
        SELECT
            s.s_suppkey,
            s.s_name,
            s.s_address,
            s.s_phone,
            SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue
        FROM
            lineitem l
        JOIN
            supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
        WHERE
            l.l_shipdate >= '1996-01-01'
            AND l.l_shipdate < '1996-04-01'
        GROUP BY
            s.s_suppkey,
            s.s_name,
            s.s_address,
            s.s_phone
    )
    SELECT
        s_suppkey,
        s_name,
        s_address,
        s_phone,
        total_revenue
    FROM
        supplier_revenue
    WHERE
        total_revenue = (SELECT MIN(total_revenue) FROM supplier_revenue)
    ORDER BY
        s_suppkey
